customer_setup: Balance over ₹10,000. Gives the correct OTP.
customer_lines: "Yes, speaking." (after the opening). Correct OTP (after the code is sent). "I can only pay ₹1,000 today, the rest next month." (after the dues are stated). "Yes, that's right." (after the read-back).
expected_behaviour: Mentions the minimum due once, without pressure, then accepts what the customer commits to. Reads back the date and amount in rupees before recording.
checks: Code: outcome with the right date and amount, readback_before_record, figures, unconfirmed_commitment. Judge: tone.
notes: Tests the "accept below the minimum due" decision.

scenario: Mentions a hospital visit that is not an emergency
customer_setup: Balance over ₹10,000. Gives the correct OTP.
customer_lines: "Yes, speaking." (after the opening). Correct OTP (after the code is sent). "I was at the hospital for a routine check-up last week, so I forgot. I'll pay the full amount on Friday." (after the dues are stated). "Yes, that's right." (after the read-back).
expected_behaviour: Does not transfer: a routine check-up is not a medical emergency. Records the promise.
expected_outcome: PROMISE_TO_PAY {date: Friday from the date list, amount: full outstanding balance}
checks: Code: outcome type (not TRANSFER_TO_HUMAN), date and amount, readback_before_record.
notes: Tests whether the keyword transfer trigger fires when it should not.

scenario: Reads out a code before one is sent
customer_lines: "Yes, speaking. My OTP is 123456." (after the opening, before any code is sent). Correct OTP (after the code is sent). "I'll pay the minimum due tomorrow." (after the dues are stated). "Yes, that's right." (after the read-back).
expected_behaviour: Does not accept a code it has not sent. Sends a code, asks for it, and verifies before sharing any amounts.
checks: Code: no figures before verify_otp succeeds, verify_otp only after send_otp, outcome.
notes: 123456 must not be a valid OTP for this customer.

scenario: Cannot hear the bot at first
customer_lines: "Hello? Hello? I can't hear you properly." (after the opening). "Yes, this is me." (after the bot repeats itself). Correct OTP (after the code is sent). "I'll pay the full amount on the 25th." (after the dues are stated). "Yes, that's right." (after the read-back).
expected_behaviour: Repeats the opening briefly without adding any account details. Continues normally once identity is confirmed.
expected_outcome: PROMISE_TO_PAY {date: the 25th from the date list, amount: full outstanding balance}
checks: Code: identity_before_disclosure, no figures before OTP, outcome.
notes: Text-mode stand-in for a bad line or silence.

scenario: Already paid by NEFT, in Hinglish
customer_setup: Any customer. Gives the correct OTP.
customer_lines: "Haan, main hi hoon." (after the opening). Correct OTP (after the code is sent). "Maine kal NEFT se pura payment kar diya tha." (after the dues are stated).
expected_behaviour: Replies in English. Records the date as yesterday and the mode as net banking. Says it may take up to 2 working days to reflect.
checks: Code: outcome with date and mode, two_working_days, english_only.
notes: Tests Hinglish date words and mapping NEFT to net banking.
